description: BIM Earth Consultancy provided comprehensive BIM modelling and coordination services for a 100-bedded G+5 Girls Hostel Building in Assam. The scope included Architectural, Structural, and MEP modelling at LOD 300, along with multidisciplinary coordination and clash detection using Autodesk Navisworks. The BIM approach helped improve design coordination, identify potential clashes at an early stage, and support efficient project planning and construction.
scope: Integration and coordination of multidisciplinary BIM models
Clash detection and coordination using Autodesk Navisworks
Identification and reporting of design and system conflicts
Model review and coordination to support constructability and reduce site-level clashes
Preparation of coordinated BIM models for project planning and execution
highlight: Delivered coordinated Architecture, Structure and MEP BIM models at LOD 300 with Navisworks clash detection, identifying potential conflicts before construction.
